name: qa-learning-coach
description: A local coach for long-term QA automation learning with daily scripts, evidence, reviews, and optional MCP progress tools.

interface.longDescription: Plan one concrete testing script or engineering improvement per study day, record evidence, review failures, and progress from UI automation through API, performance, CI/CD, reliability, and security testing.
defaultPrompt: Plan my next QA automation learning day.
Review today's test script and learning evidence.
Suggest the next performance testing milestone.
